family: One fixed total scale-header language in family.py and engine.py PolyPlan/PolyEngine. At large actual length N the first L=ceil(log2 N) input bits encode S-1. Every scale1<=S<=2^L is evaluated, rejected large plans give zero, and the finite small cutoff uses the fixed legacy evaluator. Put z=ceil(log2 L). Exact parameters are k=P2(S^13 L^15 z^43),h=e=P2(S L^2 z^5),ell=P2(S^3 L^4 z^13),eprime=P2(S^5 L^6 z^18),d=P2(S^9 L^10 z^33),Y=P2(S^11 L^13 z^38). Independence order h is separate from binary index alphabet2, with d0 rounds. Initial dimension10000 is fixed, five internal dimensions equal z, and design dimension equals w=ceil(log2 r). Robust design uses m=floor(delta*r), b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w^5/(30*10^24)), u=2b+2w+10, delta=10^-12. Its hash field degree is1000w; fresh A1 precision101w+10, largest admissible chunks and O(w^3) calls use O(w^5) seed. Every header and field/matrix datum is an actual input bit; large condenser fields are computed deterministically. Existence of one fixed S0 proves only restriction hardness; evaluation and NP eligibility hold on every header and data string. No advice, witness or good parameter is supplied externally.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P and hence NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in the pinned full B2 model, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^15*(log2(log2 N))^43. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^15*(log2(log2 N))^(43+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(15+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. The proof fixes one ordinary constant header S0. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P=L+O(S0^5 L^6 z^20)=o(k). The supplied gate theorem4n-8d covers all16 B2 tables and arbitrary sharing. The supplied robust-function moment proof has degree and log-error threshold O(r^2*u). Layout coverage loses only a factor2^O_S0((log r)^4), so actual bad-coordinate accounting still holds. Neither an explicit numerical B nor efficient search for S0 is asserted or needed for eligibility.
